name: MINNESOTA STATE FAIRGROUNDS
status: In scope by explicit user request. Dedicated playable destination in design; terrain, native doors, scripts and pack publication are not implemented.
identity: A fair to explore and do things in: a midway, livestock and 4-H barns, dairy exhibits, food stalls, a show ring and a fairground loop. Separate map, not a fair sign or one vendor in the city.
extent_policy: Fit the actual activities and readable native player cameras before freezing dimensions. Do not reserve a huge empty rectangle or shrink every activity into one plaza.

access.kind: Public walking gate from the current St. Paul exterior design, with an actual reciprocal return and room for two-way passage.
access.anchor_status: St. Paul source reservation: contiguous two-core public street to the north edge. Neighbor fairgrounds south port, native offset and return remain unbound until the grounds are authored and reviewed.
access.rail_connection: Walk from St. Paul Union Depot through the city to the fair gate; Glacier Line is useful access, not a teleport inside the grounds.
access.admission: No new mandatory main-story fee or rail-pass requirement. Optional shop purchases and game costs must be shown before spending.
access.progression: Optional regional destination. No badge, Q03 courier victory, Q06 depot flag, Safari permit or champion requirement is granted merely by entering.

districts.purpose: Recognizable gate, readable grounds map, information volunteer, fountain or planted meeting point and clear exits to both sides of the fair loop.

Distinct ride silhouettes, fenced queues, two native-script activities and a prize booth. All passable platforms must lead somewhere useful; moving ride presentation requires explicit Rust support and is not assumed to exist.
At least one fully enterable barn, a small show ring, regional creature/handler pairs and a 4-H learning activity. Pens have solid native fences, real gates and connected public viewing paths.

Enterable cold exhibit and butter-sculpture display tied to the existing Chislet/Buttermuse family. Dialogue or a demonstrator activity gives the exhibit a purpose; a building facade alone is insufficient.

Food-on-a-stick stalls, cookie stand and public picnic tables. Vendor menus use native inventory/money/shop behavior; do not scatter item balls as fake vendors. Doughlin/Crumband habitat follows the existing roster identities.

A visible trainer demonstration or optional small battle event, resting/seating space and a useful return connection to the entry. A grassy field must serve the ring or an encounter/activity rather than being avoidable filler.

activity_contracts.behavior: Three distinct stations: barn volunteer, dairy demonstrator and midway host. Native flags record each interaction. Prize clerk awards once only after all three; a full bag must leave the reward claim recoverable.
activity_contracts.status: Planned; no reward or completion flags registered yet.

activity_contracts.behavior: Original regional creature question with native menu choices and dialogue branches. Show any cost first, allow B cancellation, and prevent retry spam from duplicating a once-only reward.
activity_contracts.status: Planned; exact question, prize and cost require authored source.

activity_contracts.behavior: Optional legal trainer party with visible invitation, native battle outcome, selected move PP changes and repeat dialogue. A win cannot stand in for a regional gym badge.
activity_contracts.status: Planned; trainer party and levels not yet frozen.

existing_creature_links.scope: Use the existing cookie-family design and identities. No extra generic food creature or silent encounter mutation.
Use the existing butter-sculptor design. Native encounter/gift placement remains separately reviewable.

map_acceptance: Complete whole grounds render with every gate, district, pen, visible door and return loop; inspect actual160×144 approach and weakest routine segment.
Explicit native tile varieties distinguish midway, barns, dairy exhibit, food row and ring without prop scattering or wide vacant paving.
Connected roads and queues, ordinary return paths around any one-way ledges, physical fences/bollards and visible closure of reachable water boundaries.
Exact exterior DOOR quadrants, safe passive Floor arrivals and reciprocal room/gate exits; no decorative facade door promises.
Source collision and negative checks followed by native VisibleShellController entry/return, each activity, purchase/cancel, battle, reward-full-bag recovery and Save/Continue.
Retain every original render, rejected pass, source snapshot, conversion, crop, preview and native capture for reuse.
